Package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.protocol

Enum Class HdfsConstants.StoragePolicy

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<HdfsConstants.StoragePolicy>
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.protocol.HdfsConstants.StoragePolicy
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<HdfsConstants.StoragePolicy>, Constable
Enclosing class:
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.protocol.HdfsConstants
public static enum HdfsConstants.StoragePolicy extends Enum<HdfsConstants.StoragePolicy>
This enum wraps above Storage Policy ID and name. Recommend to use this enum instead of above static variables. For example, StoragePolicy.HOT.value() is equal to HOT_STORAGE_POLICY_ID StoragePolicy.HOT.name() is equal to HOT_STORAGE_POLICY_NAME
